steps.text: You come to beneath the pines, the smoke of Emberfall still at your back.
Aldric:  Easy, now. You walked a long way just to fall down in an old man's glade.
Aldric:  They called me something once, down in the low country. A hero, if you believe the songs. I stopped believing them.
Aldric:  So I came up here, to the quiet, and let the trees forget my name for me.
Aldric:  But the quiet's ending. South of here the mountain burns, the volcano is waking, and its embers reach for the town.
Aldric:  Someone has to go down into that fire and end it. And you have the look of someone with little left to lose.
Aldric:  I've two gifts left in me. A blade, for a steady hand, or the flame, for a restless mind. Choose what suits you.
Aldric:  Good. Go and learn its weight. Fish the lake, warm yourself, live a little. The mountain will still be waiting.
